verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents bulk-oriented capabilities: batch retrieval of custom object records, bulk import of multiple objects (companies, deals, activities) with associations, and automatic/manual deduplication across large record sets, plus workflows to automate processes at scale. However, the evidence pack doesn't show explicit batch create/update/delete endpoints for core objects like contacts or deals (only single-record POST is shown), nor any AI-native bulk operation via MCP/agent tooling beyond single-item CRUD examples. Missing for 10: explicit batch API documentation for contacts/deals/tickets, evidence of MCP or AI agent performing multi-item bulk actions, and independent confirmation of bulk operation reliability at scale.
